Name of Test Case: Open chat widget by clicking floating action button
Action to Take: Click floating 'Ask Tekton' sparkle button in bottom-right corner.
Expected Outcome: Chat panel slides open smoothly; displays greeting message and quick starter prompts.

Action to Take: Click prompt pill 'When are services?' above chat input.
Expected Outcome: Submits query to /chat; assistant replies with accurate Sunday and midweek gathering times.

Name of Test Case: Inquire about upcoming gatherings and events
Action to Take: Type 'What events are happening this week?' and hit Enter.
Expected Outcome: Assistant queries calendar data and returns scheduled gatherings with dates and times.

Name of Test Case: Ask volunteer question 'How can I get involved?'
Action to Take: Type 'How can I get involved in serving?' and send.
Expected Outcome: Assistant explains serving opportunities and provides interactive suggestion link to Serve page.

Name of Test Case: Click inline chat navigation link to jump to Plan Your Visit
Action to Take: Click assistant's suggested action button 'Plan your visit'.
Expected Outcome: Chat closes and app navigates directly to '#/guests/plan' with focus on visit form.

Name of Test Case: Submit pastoral prayer request with contact details
Action to Take: Type 'Please pray for my mother recovering from surgery. My email is mary@example.org' and send.
Expected Outcome: Assistant detects care request, files connection request via action 'hand_off_to_staff', and confirms request saved.

Name of Test Case: Instant staff queue notification for filed prayer request
Action to Take: Observe staff navigation badge immediately after filing prayer request.
Expected Outcome: onRequestFiled callback fires; staff navigation badge count increments by 1 instantly.

Action to Take: Ask 'Where is the church located?' followed by 'Is there parking there?'.
Expected Outcome: Assistant recalls previous reference to church address and answers parking question in context.

Name of Test Case: Complex theological inquiry when AI service is in demo mode
Action to Take: Ask chat assistant 'What is the church's view on eschatology and the millennium?' when LLM is unconfigured.
Expected Outcome: Provides helpful theological overview based on church doctrine.

Name of Test Case: Prayer request filing without valid contact info provided
Action to Take: In chat, say 'Please pray for me' and close chat before providing name or contact.
Expected Outcome: Assistant prompts user for name/contact before filing request.
